info.title: Assured Workloads API

requests.description: Deletes the workload. Make sure that workload's direct children are already in a deleted state, otherwise the request will fail with a FAILED_PRECONDITION error. In addition to assuredworkloads.workload.delete permission, the user should also have orgpolicy.policy.set permission on the deleted folder to remove Assured Workloads OrgPolicies.
requests.name: DELETE /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves Assured Workload Violation based on ID.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates an existing workload. Currently allows updating of workload display_name and labels. For force updates don't set etag field in the Workload. Only one update operation per workload can be in progress.
requests.name: PATCH /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists operations that match the specified filter in the request. If the server doesn't support this method, it returns `UNIMPLEMENTED`.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{name}/operations
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Acknowledges an existing violation. By acknowledging a violation, users acknowledge the existence of a compliance violation in their workload and decide to ignore it due to a valid business justification. Acknowledgement is a permanent operation and it cannot be reverted.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{name}:acknowledge
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Restrict the list of resources allowed in the Workload environment. The current list of allowed products can be found at https://cloud.google.com/assured-workloads/docs/supported-products In addition to assuredworkloads.workload.update permission, the user should also have orgpolicy.policy.set permission on the folder resource to use this functionality.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{name}:restrictAllowedResources
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the Violations in the AssuredWorkload Environment. Callers may also choose to read across multiple Workloads as per [AIP-159](https://google.aip.dev/159) by using '-' (the hyphen or dash character) as a wildcard character instead of workload-id in the parent. Format `organizations/{org_id}/locations/{location}/workloads/-`
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/violations
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists Assured Workloads under a CRM Node.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/workloads
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/workloads
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Analyzes a hypothetical move of a source project or project-based workload to a target (destination) folder-based workload.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{project}/{target}:analyzeWorkloadMove
requests.note: Replace {{ASSURED_WORKLOADS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{source}/{target}:analyzeWorkloadMove
